entry.title: Why Most Enterprise AI Projects Never Get Past the Pilot Stage
entry.summary: Enterprise AI keeps stalling at the pilot stage because the underlying data can't be trusted. AI doesn't create organizational problems but it exposes the ones you already have. Before picking a model, get your data governance, architecture and business context right. The future of enterprise AI isn't about better models. It's about information architecture.Read All

entry.title: Why AI Adoption Has Nothing to Do With Age
entry.summary: Tech adoption isn’t driven by age—it’s driven by curiosity, resources, and learning agility. The “50+ tech user” is a misleading stereotype that hides bigger behavioral differences within generations than between them. As AI scales, companies that rely on age instead of mindset will misread their users.Read All
